name: arial-sans-stack
note: Multi-family stack in layout landing on a sans face via the chrome fallback table: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif resolves Arial -> Liberation Sans and lays out/wraps with the resolved face, matching Chrome's fontconfig resolution on this system. Exercises a third chrome fallback entry (sans branch) at layout time.
